transports.name: app-server --http
transports.description: Full HTTP/SSE Runtime API under /v1/*; canonical runtime surface
transports.auth: bearer token from --auth-token, CODEWHALE_RUNTIME_TOKEN, or DEEPSEEK_RUNTIME_TOKEN; /v1/runtime/info and /health are unauthenticated
transports.notes: Contract-tested: auth boundary, thread create idempotency (201 + same id on replay, 409 on changed data), event replay, interrupt, history, usage, unknown-route 404.

transports.name: app-server --stdio
transports.description: Smaller JSON-RPC compatibility transport; tool-free turns require allowed_tools: []
transports.notes: Not selected: help states it lacks tools/approvals/full journal.

transports.name: app-server --socket
transports.description: Desktop daemon JSON-RPC on a user-private local endpoint; requires daemon/attach
transports.notes: Not selected: narrower compatibility controls and extra attach handshake.

transports.name: exec
transports.description: Headless one-shot CLI; --auto offers tools with Full Access by default
transports.notes: Qualified as a one-shot benchmark/diagnostic path only. It emits per-request usage and wire tool-schema evidence.

inventory_scope: Top-level CLI commands with captured help, the runtime route table extracted from the installed binary, effective configuration, transports, and the extension surfaces read or exercised at P17 (MCP, skills, plugins, hooks, workspace instructions). Remaining subcommand and terminal deep-dive stays P18.

coverage_notes.upstream_overlap: This build already ships a browser client (`codewhale web`, `codewhale rc`) and a runtime server (`serve`, `app-server`). Per spec section 2.3, reassess upstream desktop progress at G0 and before release instead of duplicating it blindly.
coverage_notes.note: qualified = exercised against the live 0.10.2 binary; read-qualified = read path exercised without mutation; discovered = help captured only; unavailable-by-choice = intentionally not surfaced in 1.0.

runtime_api.discovery_method: ASCII route strings extracted from the installed binary, then contract-tested on the live server; no route invented from prose.
observed_limitations: terminal_stream/terminal_input/terminal_resize/terminal_kill report false in this build; terminal routes exist but are not capability-advertised.
/v1/runtime/info is unauthenticated discovery metadata (loopback-only); stateful routes require the bearer token.
A second Windows runtime can create and run turns in a workspace another runtime drives; safe simultaneous mutation is not proven, so Mona serializes execution by default until P04/P07 own a lease.

CLI exec and runtime turns report different endpoint fingerprints (6a440b42... vs 812b1f7c...) for the same deepseek route; parity is proven by wire model/dialect/tool-schema, not by fingerprint. Investigate at P03/P16.
